## searching-h
Searching and applying
Jobs at once
How many applications the desk fills at the same time.
1
2
3
4
5
Don't wait for me
A sign-in or an emailed code waits on its card, and the other jobs carry on.
Off: a sign-in or emailed code holds the other jobs until you're done, or 5 minutes pass.
Search by itself every 12 hours
The desk searches again when the openings are over 12 hours old. Never while the queue is paused.
Troubleshooting
For getting the desk going at more employers. It searches every list and shows only the openings where the desk doesn't go all the way yet. Nothing is submitted while it is on.

## pw-h
Site passwords
0 of 8 saved
One password per job system: the desk makes your account at each of its employers and signs you in. It stays on this computer; Claude never sees it.
Workday: Applied Materials, KLA, Intel and 12 more
SuccessFactors: TSMC Arizona, Amkor Technology, Edwards Vacuum and 4 more
iCIMS: Daifuku America, Fujifilm
ApplicantStack: SCREEN SPE USA
UKG Pro: Nikon Precision, Ultra Clean Holdings (UCT)
Infor: Benchmark Electronics
Taleo
Your email: an app password, to read sign-up codes and password resets
Anthropic API key: for cover letters, instead of your Claude login
Save
How this works
Each employer has its own account on its job site. Save one password for a job system and the desk creates your account at each of that system's employers (agreeing to its terms for you) and signs you in, on that system's own sites only; when a site turns the password down, it resets that account's password to this one through the site's "Forgot password" email (unless your profile says manage_accounts: false). It stays on this computer, in its password vault (Windows Credential Manager, the macOS Keychain or your desktop's keyring; ~/.job-apply/secrets.yaml where there's none), and Claude never sees it. Use passwords you don't use anywhere else.
Your email: with an app password for the address in your profile (for Gmail, make one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords; it needs 2-Step Verification), a job waiting on an emailed code or link gets it from your inbox: only mail from that job's site that arrived after it began waiting, read without marking anything read. Without one, with email_codes: true in your profile and the Gmail connector in Claude, Claude reads it through Gmail while the desk's chat is open (only that job's own mail), and the desk puts it in.
An Anthropic API key (make one in the Claude Console, console.anthropic.com, and add some credit under Billing): with Write a cover letter for each job on, Claude writes each letter through Anthropic's API with it (about 10 to 20 cents a letter, written and checked), so the desk doesn't need Claude Code or your Claude login for them. Each letter is checked against your resume and profile the same way.

## phone-h
Phone alerts
Off
A push on your phone when a job needs you or is ready for your Submit, and a summary of the day, with this page closed too (while the desk runs). Free, through the ntfy app.
Turn on phone alerts
How this works
The alerts go through ntfy's servers to the topic your phone subscribes to. So they say only counts and kinds ("A job needs you: a bot check", "2 applications are ready for your Submit"), never an employer, a job or anything about you, unless you turn on Say which employer and job. The topic is a long random name kept on this computer, with your passwords; Turn off forgets it (a new one is made next time). One alert a job a stop, those that come together in one; the summary at the time you pick (empty: none). To use your own ntfy server, set phone_alerts_server under settings: in your profile.

## program-h
This program
Version 0.0.0.
The desk runs inside Claude here. It stops when you close Claude.

## how-h
How the desk works
Find jobs searches the career sites of the employers on your lists, and ranks what it finds against your profile.
You pick openings and press Apply to selected. The desk fills each application in the desk's browser window, up to its review page.
When a site needs you (a question, a sign-in, a bot check), the job waits under Needs you on the Home page.
Nothing is submitted until you press Submit, unless you turned on "Submit for me". LinkedIn and Indeed are always submitted by you.
Answers you give here are saved in ~/.job-apply/answers.yaml unless you untick "remember".

## notes-card-h
Notes on the desk's stops
Each time a job stops on something the desk most likely got wrong, it takes a note. Filing the notes is how the next version gets better.
Notes (2)
